title: AID Protocol v2 — PlanBoundaryManifest (P064 E-064-1_2)
$comment: producer: FSM (plan-branch lifecycle), consumers: [lib/aid-plan-manifest.sh, C4, PM brief]. Descriptive/documentation contract only — NOT loaded or enforced by aid-protocol-validate.sh (that script only proves payload-key presence, step 12, exit 12). The conditional invariants noted below are enforced by a LATER step (lib/aid-plan-manifest.sh, hand-written jq -e checks), not by this schema.
description: Type-specific schema for plan-boundary-manifest.json — the record tracking a plan branch's EPICs, task branches, and integration heads through the plan-branch lifecycle (plan/Pxxx as the integration branch for a plan's EPICs). Path: .aid-o/work/plan-state/<plan_id>/plan-boundary-manifest.json.

allOf.$comment: extends aid-protocol-v2.schema.json envelope (reference only — not a resolved $ref)

plan_boundary_manifest.$comment: enforced — payload-key presence only (step 12, exit 12). Field-level shape below is descriptive/documentation, not runtime-enforced by aid-protocol-validate.sh.

candidate_sha.description: Non-null requires plan_state in PLAN_GATES, PLAN_REVIEW, AWAITING_PM, PLAN_MERGING, CLOSED. NOT enforced here — see Step 3 (lib/aid-plan-manifest.sh).

active_epics.description: Must be a subset of epics. NOT enforced here — see Step 3 (lib/aid-plan-manifest.sh).

total_epics.description: Must equal epics length. NOT enforced here — see Step 3 (lib/aid-plan-manifest.sh).

is_plan_final.description: True only in PLAN_SYNC or later. NOT enforced here — see Step 3 (lib/aid-plan-manifest.sh).

plan_final_required_profile.description: Monotonically non-decreasing relative to epic_required_profile. NOT enforced here — see Step 3 (lib/aid-plan-manifest.sh).

epic_id.description: Must be a member of epics. NOT enforced here — see Step 3 (lib/aid-plan-manifest.sh).

epic_base_commit.description: The plan head observed at epic-start.

epic_source_ref.description: The ref the branch was created from; null only for a repaired entry that could not prove its origin.

epic_merge_commit.description: Non-null requires status: merged_to_plan. NOT enforced here — see Step 3 (lib/aid-plan-manifest.sh).

evidence_dir.description: Must start with .aid-o/work/evidence/<epic_id>/. Path containment (no ..) is checked by Step 3 (lib/aid-plan-manifest.sh), not here.

plan_final_run_id.description: Non-null requires plan_final_evidence_dir non-null and vice versa. NOT enforced here — see Step 3 (lib/aid-plan-manifest.sh).

plan_final_evidence_dir.description: Non-null requires plan_final_run_id non-null and vice versa. Path containment (no ..) is checked by Step 3 (lib/aid-plan-manifest.sh), not here.
